purpose: Source registry supporting the religious atlas. Sources are used according to evidence type; no single source is treated as sufficient for every field.

rules: Use primary institutional sources for self-description but label them as self-description.
Use national censuses and representative surveys for demographic claims where available.
Use specialist academic literature for contested timeline and historical reconstruction.
Use archaeological and manuscript catalogues for material/textual evidence.
Do not convert theological claims into empirical facts.
Do not treat a broad demographic category as a denomination or theological school.
For Potatoism, repository/project records establish project timeline and self-description; external religious history is comparative evidence only.
